feedback_by_option.fil: Iginagalang ang gamit ng pamilya, pero hindi nito ipinapakita kung aling halaman ang nasa card.
feedback_by_option.en: Family use is respected, but it does not show which plant is on the card.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ang current card na may botanical name ang tamang simula.
feedback_by_option.en: A current card with the botanical name is the proper start.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi sapat na patunay ng identity ang larawan.
feedback_by_option.en: A picture alone does not establish identity.

feedback_by_option.fil: Parehong may ganoong pangalan ang dalawa; hindi patunay ng identity ang pangalan.
feedback_by_option.en: Both plants share the name; a name alone does not confirm identity.

feedback_by_option.fil: Walang clinical o lokal na pahintulot ang lumang dose.
feedback_by_option.en: The old dose has no clinical or local authorization.

feedback_by_option.fil: Mauuna ang clinical advice bago ang anumang paghahanda o paggamit.
feedback_by_option.en: Clinical advice comes before any preparation or use.
